description.zh-CN: 沿用已选企业 CLI 配置档的权限设置。
description.en-US: Use the permission settings of the selected enterprise CLI profile.

description.zh-CN: 允许工作区内操作，访问网络或编辑工作区外的文件时请求批准。
description.en-US: Allow workspace operations and request approval for network access or edits outside the workspace.

description.zh-CN: 保留工作区权限边界，由 TRAE 审核符合条件的审批请求。
description.en-US: Keep workspace restrictions and let TRAE review eligible approval requests.

description.zh-CN: 工作区外的编辑及网络访问无需询问，仍受企业策略约束。
description.en-US: Allow edits outside the workspace and network access without asking, subject to enterprise policy.
